body.title: The five aggregate prompts describe their input as it is rendered
body.summary: Correct, in the five aggregate system prompts (src/prompts/analyze/code, data, docs, generic and infra .aggregate.system.md), the description of the block `Upstream task outputs:`: one `### <output name>` section per name, and, when several tasks produced the name, one `#### <name> from task <taskId> (<template>)` sub-section per task with its `params:` line; the report must cover every sub-section. No other instruction of the prompts changes.
acceptanceChecks: None of the five prompts says one `### <taskId>` section per input; each describes the name section and the per-task sub-section in the words the renderer uses.
Apart from that description, each prompt's text is unchanged.
The prompt validation that runs at daemon boot still passes for the five files.

tests.name: each of the five aggregate prompts describes the block as it is rendered and no longer says one section per task id
